scenario: emit X logical per LLOG.1.1 — an emitted fact's lifetime is tied to its justifying LHS. Assert Trig, pump: Occupied is asserted. Retract Trig, pump: CLIPS truth maintenance retracts Occupied automatically.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Occupied scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    emit Occupied logical dummy: 0
